title: Cloud Deployment Engineer (Secret Clearance Required) - Remote With 30% Travel
job_description:
Secret Clearance Required | Remote with Travel

Location: Remote (U.S.) with up to 30% travel

Travel: Customer deployments in Ogden, UT; Oklahoma City, OK; Montgomery, AL; and other U.S. classified data center locations as required

Clearance Required: Active DoD Secret Clearance or higher


About the Opportunity

Our team is seeking an experienced Cloud Deployment Engineer to support the deployment, integration, and sustainment of modern infrastructure platforms within classified Department of Defense environments. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy hands-on infrastructure work and have deep experience deploying Linux, VMware, and Kubernetes platforms in enterprise or government environments. You will work alongside a highly technical team responsible for standing up private cloud environments, integrating multi-vendor technologies, hardening systems, and supporting mission-critical deployments. This position is primarily remote but requires travel to customer sites for infrastructure deployments, upgrades, integration efforts, and troubleshooting activities.


Required Qualifications

Must Have:

Active DoD Secret Clearance or higher
Expert-level experience building and deploying Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL)
Expert-level experience deploying and administering VMware environments
Experience deploying and supporting Kubernetes platforms
Experience operating within enterprise data center environments
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
Ability to travel up to 30% as project requirements dictate


Preferred Qualifications

Top Secret clearance
Experience supporting DoD, Federal Government, or classified environments
Experience with STIG implementation and security remediation
Experience with VMware Cloud Foundation, NSX, vSAN, vCenter, or ESXi
Experience with OpenShift, Rancher, RKE2, or other enterprise Kubernetes distributions
Experience with automation tools such as Ansible, Terraform, or GitLab CI/CD
Experience with AWS, Azure, or other public cloud environments
Knowledge of networking concepts including VLANs, routing, security zones, and load balancing
Knowledge of enterprise storage technologies and SAN architectures


Responsibilities

Deploy, configure, and integrate Linux, VMware, and Kubernetes platforms in classified environments
Install, patch, and harden infrastructure utilizing DISA STIG requirements and security best practices
Build and maintain RHEL operating system images and lifecycle processes
Deploy and configure VMware virtual infrastructure including ESXi, vSphere, and related components
Implement Kubernetes-based container platforms and support platform integration efforts
Troubleshoot infrastructure, networking, storage, virtualization, and application issues
Support customer data center deployments and on-site implementation activities
Integrate identity, security, monitoring, and logging solutions across multiple technology platforms
Remediate vulnerabilities and support compliance initiatives
Create deployment documentation, implementation guides, and operational procedures
Collaborate with engineering, security, and customer stakeholders to ensure successful project execution


What Makes Someone Successful in This Role

The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in Linux engineering, VMware infrastructure, and Kubernetes deployments, with experience supporting highly secure environments. They are comfortable working independently, traveling to customer locations, and troubleshooting complex infrastructure issues across compute, networking, storage, and container platforms.


If you enjoy building environments from the ground up, solving difficult technical challenges, and supporting mission-critical deployments, we'd love to speak with you.

Job Type & Location

This is a Contract position based out of Washington, D.C..

Pay and Benefits

The pay range for this position is $80.00 - $110.00/hr.

Individual compensation offered for this position within this range will depend on many factors, including qualifications, skills, relevant experience, job knowledge, geographic location, internal equity, and other pertinent job-related factors.

Eligibility requirements apply to some benefits and may depend on your job classification and length of employment. Benefits are subject to change and may be subject to specific elections, plan, or program terms. If eligible, the benefits available for this temporary role may include the following: • Medical, dental & vision • Critical Illness, Accident, and Hospital • 401(k) Retirement Plan – Pre-tax and Roth post-tax contributions available • Life Insurance (Voluntary Life & AD&D for the employee and dependents) • Short and long-term disability • Health Spending Account (HSA) • Transportation benefits • Employee Assistance Program • Time Off/Leave (PTO, Vacation or Sick Leave)

Workplace Type

This is a fully remote position.

Application Deadline

This position is anticipated to close on Sep 18, 2026.
